details: Paired slender vertical posts at each end of every piece, terminating at the floor in stacked square block feet with thin horizontal cross-bars
Thick slab-like top rails and dresser top that oversail the posts, each with a thinner secondary rail immediately below
Small square block capitals on the dresser mirror posts at about mirror mid-height, matching the square geometry of the feet
Square drawer pulls arranged on a regular grid: one centred on each of three small top drawers, two on each of three long drawers
Small hatched section cuts through a horizontal member with a chamfered end, drawn at the right-hand post of the dresser mirror frame and again at the headboard
